WITCH 3D Graphics Program

Tape 1: Setup & Edge printout
Tape 2: Vector * Matrix multiplication
Tape 3: 16 element matrix - model and projection in one
Tape 4: Wirefram 3d model
        Block 1: Number of verticies V followed by 3*V XYZ triples
        Block 2: Number of edges E followed by 2*E vertex index pairs

Output:
    V X,Y Pairs, one pair per line
    blank lines
    E A,B pairs, edge pairs, indexes into Vertex list

Draw & label verticies on graph paper, numbering from ZERO
For each edge pair, connect vertex A to vertex B with a ruler

TODO I GOT MY GROUPS ALL FUCKED UP

; Prepare for point transform loop

29900   ; Clear 99
10499   ; Load vertex count from tape 4 into 99
28900   ; Clear 89
10189   ; load constant 0.01 to 89
*00010

; goto point transform loop
03102   ;Search tape 2 block 1
02102   ;Transfer control to tape2

[2] ;TODO Run this from memory to save time?
;Prepare for segment printout

10001

29900   ; Clear 99
10499   ; Load edge count from tape 4 into 99
38999   ; Decrement count

10401

05301   ;   If so search tape 1 block 3
00100   ; Else Finish

; Point Transform Loop
tape2(looped)
[1]
